dogecoin.text:
Red across the board for memecoins:

→ $DOGE down ~8% → ~$0.21

→ $PEPE down 9% → ~$0.0000115

→ $BONK down ~8% → ~$0.000027

→ $PENGU also bleeding double‑digits

What’s driving it:

→ Macro heat: U.S. tariff announcements and a stronger dollar sparked $758M in https://t.co/PCuHWAuj6Q

Grayscale just filed an S-1 for its Dogecoin ETF, moving DOGE one step closer to Wall Street.

If approved, it would hold only DOGE, use Coinbase Custody, track the CoinDesk Dogecoin Price Index, and list on NYSE Arca. 

The sponsor fee starts at 2.5%, likely to drop post-launch.
